usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove an ACME challenge plugin configuration from Proxmox Datacenter Manager. The caller must hold the System.Modify privilege on the system/certificates ACL path. Before deleting, ensure no ACME accounts or domains are still referencing this plugin, as removal is immediate and returns null (synchronous, no UPID).

examples.summary: Delete a DNS challenge plugin named 'cloudflare-dns'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named ACME plugin configuration; any ACME account or certificate order that references this plugin will fail to renew until a replacement plugin is configured.
tips: The plugin ID must match the pattern ^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9.\-_]*)$ and is case-sensitive.
This call returns null on success — a 200 with no body is the expected success response.
List existing plugins first with get_config_acme_plugins to confirm the exact ID before deleting.
